#!/usr/bin/env python3
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import os
import shutil
import stat
import subprocess
import sys
import tarfile
import tempfile
import zipfile
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path, PurePosixPath

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
PRIMARY = ROOT / "source" / "primary"
STAGING = ROOT / "source" / "staging"
LOCK_FILE = ROOT / "source" / "SOURCE_LOCK.json"
EXPECTED_COMMIT = "c1ec1915fc16f3dc1ec5d47d9a97f6210a574526"
EXPECTED_REMOTE = "https://github.com/pingdotgg/t3code.git"
MAX_ARCHIVE_UNCOMPRESSED = 2 * 1024 * 1024 * 1024


def run(*args: str, cwd: Path | None = None, check: bool = True) -> str:
    proc = subprocess.run(args, cwd=cwd, text=True, capture_output=True)
    if check and proc.returncode != 0:
        raise RuntimeError(f"command failed ({proc.returncode}): {' '.join(args)}\n{proc.stderr}")
    return proc.stdout.strip()


def git(repo: Path, *args: str, check: bool = True) -> str:
    return run("git", "-C", str(repo), *args, check=check)


def sha256_file(path: Path) -> str:
    digest = hashlib.sha256()
    with path.open("rb") as handle:
        for block in iter(lambda: handle.read(1024 * 1024), b""):
            digest.update(block)
    return digest.hexdigest()


def content_digest(root: Path) -> tuple[str, int, int]:
    digest = hashlib.sha256()
    files = 0
    total_bytes = 0
    for current, dirs, names in os.walk(root, followlinks=False):
        current_path = Path(current)
        dirs[:] = sorted(d for d in dirs if d != ".git")
        for name in sorted(names):
            path = current_path / name
            rel = path.relative_to(root).as_posix()
            if rel.startswith(".git/"):
                continue
            if path.is_symlink():
                data = os.readlink(path).encode("utf-8", "surrogateescape")
                kind = b"L"
            else:
                data = path.read_bytes()
                kind = b"F"
            digest.update(kind + b"\0" + rel.encode() + b"\0" + len(data).to_bytes(8, "big") + data)
            files += 1
            total_bytes += len(data)
    return digest.hexdigest(), files, total_bytes


def archive_path_is_safe(value: str) -> bool:
    normalized = value.replace("\\", "/")
    path = PurePosixPath(normalized)
    return not path.is_absolute() and ".." not in path.parts


def safe_extract_zip(archive: Path, target: Path) -> None:
    total = 0
    with zipfile.ZipFile(archive) as handle:
        for entry in handle.infolist():
            if not archive_path_is_safe(entry.filename):
                raise RuntimeError(f"unsafe archive entry: {entry.filename}")
            mode = (entry.external_attr >> 16) & 0o170000
            if mode == stat.S_IFLNK:
                raise RuntimeError(f"archive symlink is not accepted: {entry.filename}")
            total += entry.file_size
            if total > MAX_ARCHIVE_UNCOMPRESSED:
                raise RuntimeError("archive exceeds uncompressed size limit")
        handle.extractall(target)


def safe_extract_tar(archive: Path, target: Path) -> None:
    total = 0
    with tarfile.open(archive) as handle:
        for entry in handle.getmembers():
            if not archive_path_is_safe(entry.name):
                raise RuntimeError(f"unsafe archive entry: {entry.name}")
            if entry.issym() or entry.islnk():
                raise RuntimeError(f"archive link is not accepted: {entry.name}")
            if entry.isfile():
                total += entry.size
                if total > MAX_ARCHIVE_UNCOMPRESSED:
                    raise RuntimeError("archive exceeds uncompressed size limit")
        handle.extractall(target)


def collapse_single_root(path: Path) -> Path:
    entries = [p for p in path.iterdir() if p.name != "__MACOSX"]
    if len(entries) == 1 and entries[0].is_dir():
        return entries[0]
    return path


def clone_bundle(bundle: Path, target: Path) -> None:
    run("git", "bundle", "verify", str(bundle))
    run("git", "clone", str(bundle), str(target))


def copy_directory(source: Path, target: Path) -> None:
    shutil.copytree(source, target, symlinks=True)


def inspect_git_source(source: Path) -> dict[str, object]:
    if not (source / ".git").exists():
        return {"has_git_history": False}
    git(source, "cat-file", "-e", f"{EXPECTED_COMMIT}^{{commit}}")
    head = git(source, "rev-parse", "HEAD").lower()
    tree = git(source, "rev-parse", "HEAD^{tree}").lower()
    if head != EXPECTED_COMMIT:
        raise RuntimeError(f"Git source must be checked out at {EXPECTED_COMMIT}, got {head}")
    status = git(source, "status", "--porcelain")
    if status:
        raise RuntimeError("Git source is dirty; refusing authoritative intake")
    git(source, "fsck", "--full", "--strict")
    remote = git(source, "remote", "get-url", "origin", check=False) or None
    commit_count = int(git(source, "rev-list", "--count", "HEAD"))
    return {
        "has_git_history": True,
        "commit": head,
        "tree": tree,
        "remote": remote,
        "commit_count": commit_count,
        "git_fsck_passed": True,
        "dirty": False,
    }


def record_lock(source: Path, source_kind: str, origin: str, authoritative_no_history: bool) -> dict[str, object]:
    metadata = inspect_git_source(source)
    digest, file_count, total_bytes = content_digest(source)
    if metadata.get("has_git_history"):
        authority = "git_exact_commit"
    elif authoritative_no_history:
        authority = "explicit_history_free_authority"
    else:
        raise RuntimeError(
            "History-free source cannot prove the pinned Git commit. "
            "Provide a Git checkout/bundle or explicitly pass --authoritative-no-history."
        )
    return {
        "schema_version": 2,
        "expected_repository": EXPECTED_REMOTE,
        "expected_commit": EXPECTED_COMMIT,
        "source_kind": source_kind,
        "source_origin": origin,
        "authority": authority,
        "commit_verified": metadata.get("commit") == EXPECTED_COMMIT,
        "content_sha256": digest,
        "file_count": file_count,
        "content_bytes": total_bytes,
        "metadata": metadata,
        "ingested_at_utc": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
        "limitations": [] if metadata.get("has_git_history") else [
            "Source history was not available; exact upstream Git commit identity was explicitly asserted, not cryptographically proven."
        ],
    }


def swap_source(staged: Path, lock: dict[str, object]) -> None:
    backup = PRIMARY.with_name("primary.previous")
    temp_lock = LOCK_FILE.with_suffix(".json.tmp")
    if backup.exists():
        shutil.rmtree(backup)
    if PRIMARY.exists():
        PRIMARY.rename(backup)
    try:
        staged.rename(PRIMARY)
        temp_lock.write_text(json.dumps(lock, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
        temp_lock.replace(LOCK_FILE)
        if backup.exists():
            shutil.rmtree(backup)
    except Exception:
        if PRIMARY.exists():
            shutil.rmtree(PRIMARY)
        if backup.exists():
            backup.rename(PRIMARY)
        temp_lock.unlink(missing_ok=True)
        raise


def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    group = parser.add_mutually_exclusive_group(required=True)
    group.add_argument("--directory", type=Path)
    group.add_argument("--archive", type=Path)
    group.add_argument("--bundle", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--authoritative-no-history", action="store_true")
    args = parser.parse_args()

    STAGING.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(dir=STAGING, prefix="intake-") as temp_dir:
        temp = Path(temp_dir)
        source = temp / "source"
        if args.directory:
            origin = str(args.directory.resolve())
            copy_directory(args.directory.resolve(), source)
            source_kind = "directory"
        elif args.bundle:
            origin = str(args.bundle.resolve())
            clone_bundle(args.bundle.resolve(), source)
            source_kind = "git_bundle"
        else:
            archive = args.archive.resolve()
            origin = str(archive)
            extracted = temp / "extracted"
            extracted.mkdir()
            if zipfile.is_zipfile(archive):
                safe_extract_zip(archive, extracted)
            elif tarfile.is_tarfile(archive):
                safe_extract_tar(archive, extracted)
            else:
                raise RuntimeError("unsupported source archive")
            copy_directory(collapse_single_root(extracted), source)
            source_kind = "archive"
        lock = record_lock(source, source_kind, origin, args.authoritative_no_history)
        staged = STAGING / "validated-primary"
        if staged.exists():
            shutil.rmtree(staged)
        source.rename(staged)
        swap_source(staged, lock)
    print(f"Source ingested into {PRIMARY}")
    print(f"Authority: {lock['authority']}")
    print(f"Content SHA-256: {lock['content_sha256']}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
